items.question: What are your delivery times?
items.answer: We ship within 24h and delivery is free from €50. Allow 2-3 business days for receipt.

items.question: Can I return my products?
items.answer: Yes, you have 14 days to return your unopened products. Return costs are on us.

items.question: Are your products legal?
items.answer: Yes, all our CBD products are perfectly legal in France with less than 0.2% THC.

items.question: How to choose the right concentration?
items.answer: Start with a low concentration (5-10%) if you're a beginner, then increase according to your needs.
